title: 第2416章 曾经有人轮回第2415章 白书读书多相信白书
lines: 白书惊讶。
白书，绝对算得上是见多识广了，即便是在神界，白书的知识储备也已经超越了绝大多数的天神。
毕竟她那阅读能力，的确非凡，是天神都难以比拟的。
所以白书是真的对轮回有些理解。
绝不是什么道听途说的半吊子。
而在白书看来，这轮回庙中的千面轮回，起码目前来看，只是一个搭了一个架子而已，而且即便只是架子，也十分的简陋。
距离真正的轮回，差距很大。
许多布置甚至有些似是而非，很牵强，跟真正的轮回甚至都有些格格不入，是实在没办法，才强行布下的。
更多的不是为了塑造轮回，而是与所谓天都沟通，从而从天都那里借来轮回的力量。
白书不说多么专业，但连她都看出了这么多问题，这轮回哪还能成功？
若是当年神名殿堂没有没落，轮回庙祝仍在努力，或许真有成功的那么一天，但很可惜，当时的轮回庙祝即便思路清晰，有大野心。
但能做到的也就是这个地步而已了。
白书相信自己的判断，相信自己的眼睛。
可现在眼睛告诉她，这轮回曾经真正运转！
但这怎么可能呢！
白书揉了揉眼睛，然后敲敲脑袋，她在想是不是自己看错了，或者感知错了。
“这轮回怎么可能成功呢，这甚至连半成品都算不上！”白书黛眉紧蹙，挠着头完全想不明白。
这太奇怪了。
只能是她判断出错才对。
“在这里吗，这是文字！”白书反复验证，锁定了那轮回痕迹的源头。
她从那亿兆浑天仪上的轮回特性中，抽离出两个文字。
两个文字极为繁复，笔画繁多，同时每一笔都是玄奥非常，其中所代表的规则大道，超乎想象，是极其可怕的！
白书并不认识这两个字。
但她一眼就能够辨认出这两个字到底是什么。
“轮回二字！”
白书眼睛一亮，振奋了起来。
这轮回特性之中，竟然还藏着“轮回”二字。
难怪白书能够有刚才那样的感应，就是因为这两个字。
白书，身为九天斩神诀九柄神剑之一，她最大的特点不是生前逆天一般的阅读能力，而是成为剑之后，铭刻文字的力量！
她身上，有不少强大无比的古代文字。
正是因为她对文字的这种特殊感应，才能够从轮回特性中寻到这“轮回”二字，换做别人，即便境界实力超越白书不少，恐怕也是做不到的。
“不是古代文字，但，是类似的存在”，白书眼睛明亮，不住的闪动着。
古代文字。
只是因为出现的年代古老而得名，事实上，当世也可以新造文字。
而古代文字的出现，也并非用笔来书写，而是以自身大道凝聚，是大道的具现方式，文字本身，便是大道本身！
眼前这文字，出现在神界，当然不是古代文字。
但其根本，却与古代文字一样，也是规则大道的具现。
content_en:
Bai Shu was surprised.
Bai Shu is definitely well-informed. Even in the God Realm, Bai Shu's knowledge reserve has surpassed that of most gods.
After all, her reading ability is indeed extraordinary, unmatched even by gods.
So Bai Shu really has some understanding of reincarnation.
This is by no means some half-baked rumor.
In Bai Shu's view, the Thousand Faces of Reincarnation in the Reincarnation Temple, at least for now, is just a shelf, and even if it is just a shelf, it is very crude.
There is a huge gap between true reincarnation.
Many of the arrangements are even somewhat specious, far-fetched, and even incompatible with real reincarnation. They were forcibly placed because there was really no other way.
The purpose is not to shape reincarnation, but to communicate with the so-called Tiandu, thereby borrowing the power of reincarnation from Tiandu.
Not to mention how professional Bai Shu was, but even she saw so many problems, how could this reincarnation be successful?
If the Temple of God's Name had not declined and Samsara Temple Zhu was still working hard, it might have succeeded one day. But it is a pity that Samsara Temple Zhu at that time had clear ideas and great ambitions.
But that's all that can be done.
Bai Shu believes in his own judgment and his own eyes.
But now her eyes told her that this reincarnation was really running!
But how is this possible!
Bai Shu rubbed her eyes and then knocked her head. She was wondering if she had seen it wrong or perceived it wrong.
"How can this reincarnation be successful? This is not even a semi-finished product!" Bai Shudai frowned and scratched her head, completely confused.
This is so strange.
It could only be that she made a mistake in judgment.
"Is it here? This is text!" Bai Shu verified it repeatedly and locked the source of the traces of reincarnation.
She extracted two words from the characteristics of reincarnation on the billions of armillary spheres.
The two words are extremely complicated, with numerous strokes. At the same time, each stroke is very mysterious. The rules and avenues represented in them are beyond imagination and extremely terrifying!
Bai Shu didn't recognize these two words.
But she could identify what those two words were at a glance.
"The word reincarnation!"
Bai Shu's eyes lit up and he became excited.
There is actually the word "reincarnation" hidden in this characteristic of reincarnation.
No wonder Bai Shu felt the way he did just now because of these two words.
Bai Shu, as one of the nine divine swords of the Nine Heavens Killing God Art, her greatest feature is not her incredible reading ability during her lifetime, but her ability to inscribe words after becoming a sword!
There are many extremely powerful ancient texts on her body.
It was precisely because of her special sense of words that she was able to find the word "reincarnation" from the characteristics of reincarnation. If it were anyone else, even if their realm and strength were much higher than Bai Shu's, they probably wouldn't be able to do it.
"It's not ancient writing, but it's similar." Bai Shu's eyes were bright and flashing.
Ancient texts.
It got its name just because it appeared in ancient times. In fact, new writing could also be created in this era.
The emergence of ancient characters was not written with a pen, but was condensed with its own avenue. It was the embodiment of the avenue. The writing itself was the avenue itself!
The text in front of me appears in the divine world, and it is certainly not an ancient text.
But its foundation is the same as ancient writing, and it is also the embodiment of the rule of law.
title_en: Chapter 2416: Someone once reincarnated Chapter 2415: The more you read Bai Shu, the more you believe in Bai Shu
